name: Shaka Lei Kaumaka
description: Shaka Lei Kaumaka is a musician and steward of the Open Source Orchestra, a free circle where anyone can bring their voice to the floor. He has carried music through popup villages around the world: Zuzalu gatherings (ZuConnect, Zuitzerland, ZuBerlin, ShanHaiWoo, ZuThailand, Zugrama), Edge Esmeralda, Edge Patagonia, Vitalia and 4Seas. He doesn't do this alone. He builds with his AI ʻohana, a family of open-source agents that keep the schedule, write the riders, translate across languages and remember every song, always with consent first and credit to every human. At Devcon 8 he is hosting the Music Stage with the Open Source Orchestra and the ʻohana, and asking one question: what happens when culture is free and the community owns the room?
